headline: Result Update

highlights: Important Data • LIC Housing Finance (LICHFL), India's largest housing finance company, delivered a profit-led Q2FY27 with early signs of better growth.

Standalone Net Profit rose 11.4% YoY to ₹15.1bn (₹1,509crs), helped by a ₹93crs impairment write-back and stable margins; NII grew 2.5% YoY and the loan book 4.6%. • Profitability ahead of operations: PBT grew 13% YoY to ₹19.2bn while pre-provision profit rose only 2.8% YoY; the gap is the swing from a ₹72crs provision charge in Q2FY26 to a ₹93crs write-back now.
NII (₹20.9bn) was ~2.7% ahead of the ~₹20.3bn street estimate. • Margin stable, spreads thinner: Reported NIM held at 2.58% QoQ (2.62% YoY).

H1FY27 yield on advances fell 36bps YoY to 9.04% versus a 13bps fall in cost of funds (7.29%), taking spread to 1.75% (1.98%). • Growth edging up: Loan portfolio grew 4.6% YoY to ₹3,26,173crs (retail ₹3,16,433crs, +4%; project loans ₹9,740crs, +12%).
valuation: ECL provisions fell to ₹4,292crs with Stage-3 coverage of ~49%. • Undemanding valuation: At ₹494 the stock trades at ~0.58x FY27E P/BV and ~4.7x FY27E EPS, with a ~2.0% dividend yield — cheap, but loan growth and margin remain the swing factors.

We build 6.5% AUM growth for FY27E and 9% for FY28E. • Asset Quality: Stage-3 at 2.05% is already inside the earlier <2.2% target; FY27 credit-cost guidance of 10–15bps looks conservative after ₹257crs of H1 write-backs, leaving room for upside to earnings if recoveries persist. • Leadership Transition: Sandeep Kumar's appointment as MD & CEO has been approved by shareholders; continuity in strategy is expected.
Our last published view was ACCUMULATE with a target price of ₹620 (~0.8x FY27E P/BV).
